en.title: Bitwise XOR Subsequences
en.description:
Find the longest subsequence of the array such that the bitwise XOR of every pair of adjacent chosen elements equals k. A subsequence of length 1 is always valid.

This site's input protocol and the explicitly stated supplementary ranges are compiled by CSWork and do not pose as the original OA rules.
en.input: The first line contains n (1..100000), followed by n lines, each with one arr[i] (0..10^6), and a final line with k (0..10^6).
en.output: Output the length of the longest valid subsequence.
en.explanation: See the accompanying solution for the approach, proof of correctness, and complexity.
hints: Maintain dp[v]: the length of the longest valid subsequence in the current prefix that ends with value v. A new value v can follow a value v XOR k.
